fee_proposition: Mandatory upfront non-refundable Specified Scheme application fee per application under Cap. 115A Schedule 2 reg. 11(6) effective 26 Feb 2025 11:00 a.m. (initial IANG entry and extensions/change of condition of stay; NOT the full cost)
applicant_category: Principal Applicant and Each Dependant Separately (Entry & Extension)
duration_band: ALL_DURATIONS (Applies per application for entry and extension/change of stay)
page_title: New Fee Structure for Visa Applications under Specified Schemes
supporting_excerpt: With effect from 11 a.m. on 26 February 2025, an application fee of $600 is payable at the time of submitting each application for entry, change of condition of stay, or extension of stay under IANG (Specified Scheme) by the principal applicant and each dependant. The application fee is non-refundable in any circumstance irrespective of the application result, refusal, cancellation, or withdrawal.
refundability: Strictly non-refundable under Cap. 115A reg. 11(6) in any circumstance regardless of approval, refusal, cancellation, or withdrawal (Note 3, Q3, Q4).

fee_proposition: Two-tiered visa / entry permit issuance fee payable UPON APPROVAL under Cap. 115A Schedule 2 Items 1(a) & 6(a) indexed to relevant period (>180 days / 6+ months = HKD 1,300; <=180 days = HKD 600); pre-26 Feb 2025 11 a.m. rules EXPIRED
applicant_category: Principal Applicant and Each Dependant Separately
duration_band: >180 days (or >=6 mos): HKD 1,300 issuance (HKD 1,900 combined w/ HKD 600 app fee, e.g. 24-mo initial); <=180 days: HKD 600 issuance (HKD 1,200 combined)
supporting_excerpt: Upon approval, visa/entry permit issuance fee under Cap. 115A Schedule 2 Specified Schemes: HK$1,300 where the relevant period of limit of stay is more than 180 days (Note: if 6 months or more, $1,300 applies), or HK$600 where the relevant period is not more than 180 days, computed per Table 3 formula. Applies separately per principal applicant and each dependant.
refundability: Issuance fee is payable only upon approval prior to downloading e-Visa; legacy /eng/services/fees/visas.html returned HTTP 404 (not cited).

fee_proposition: Extension of stay / change of condition of stay issuance tiers (HKD 1,300 >180d or HKD 600 <=180d on top of HKD 600 upfront fee), electronic payment channels, and mandatory in-Hong Kong physical presence at payment & e-Visa collection
applicant_category: Principal Applicant and Each Dependant (Extensions / Change of Stay)
duration_band: 3+3 yr renewals or 6-yr top-tier (>=HKD 2M income) -> >180d tier (HKD 1,300 issuance); short passport/remainder extension <=180d -> HKD 600 issuance
supporting_excerpt: Upon approval of IANG entry or extension (Cap. 115A Schedule 2 Item 3(a) / Specified Schemes), applicant pays online via GovHK or ImmD Mobile App (VISA, Mastercard, UnionPay, JCB, PPS, FPS, Alipay, WeChat Pay, UnionPay App) to download e-Visa. Note: Applicants applying for extension of stay must be physically present in Hong Kong at the time of fee payment and e-Visa collection.
refundability: HKD 600 application fee non-refundable at filing; issuance fee (HKD 1,300 or HKD 600) payable on approval while physically present in HK for extensions.
